about.title: I like finished software.
about.lead: I'm Treza - a software engineer who likes finished software: designed in the open, built with boring-reliable tools, and handed over working.
body: I build mobile apps and backends that ship. My work sits at the intersection of product and engineering: understand the real problem, pick the boring-reliable stack, then deliver something that works and is documented well enough that the next person can pick it up.

Right now I'm building Tikum, a touring app with live tracking and SOS alerts, an IoT system for a smart water pump, plus booking systems for travel businesses. Alongside that I automate the tedious parts with AI agents and pipelines.
I'm open to freelance and full-time work - especially mobile, backend, and AI automation projects.

approach.d: Understand the actual pain before writing a line of code. The stack follows the problem, not the other way around.
Proven tools over shiny ones. Laravel, PostgreSQL, Expo - things that are still maintained in three years.
Every project ships with a README that explains the architecture, the flows, and the trade-offs.
I use AI tools to move faster without sacrificing architecture, code quality, or clarity.
